notes.recognition: Broad grounded silhouette, green repair vials, and field case communicate a support specialist at thumbnail size.
notes.agency: The ready stance and accessible equipment imply practical intervention, though the neutral pose intentionally limits action drama.
notes.specificity: Weathered expedition cloth, mineral repair vials, and non-military equipment feel specific to Xenovoya.
notes.restraint: One figure, one equipment cluster, and quiet negative space preserve the focal read.
notes.continuity: Materials and palette fit the crew; the rendering is slightly more painterly-realistic than the three earlier line-led cutouts.
notes.reusability: Clean full-body silhouette, generous margin, and clear hand/foot shapes support board, dossier, and memory crops.
notes.accessibility: Body shape, collar, case, and vial cluster separate the role without depending on green alone.
